people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: Solomon made all the vessels that were in Yahweh’s house: the golden altar and the table that the show bread was on, of gold;
translations.bsb: Solomon also made all the furnishings for the house of the LORD: the golden altar; the golden table on which was placed the Bread of the Presence;
